title: International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy Nutrition
excerpt: Oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus — practical ways to build balanced plates
content:
## Introduction to Pregnancy Nutrition
Pregnancy nutrition is a crucial aspect of the pregnancy process. Expectant mothers need to provide their bodies with the necessary nutrients to ensure the health and well-being of both mother and baby. In this article, we will explore international pantry staples that are good for pregnancy.

## International Pantry Staples for Pregnancy
The following international pantry staples are good options for pregnant women:
- Oats: rich in fiber, helping to lower cholesterol and improve digestive health.
- Greek yogurt: rich in calcium, supporting the development of bones and teeth for the baby.
- Lentils: rich in protein, fiber, and iron, improving overall health.
- Low-mercury salmon: rich in omega-3, supporting the development of the baby's brain and vision.
- Eggs: rich in protein, vitamins, and minerals, improving overall health.
- Leafy greens and citrus: rich in vitamins and minerals, supporting immune function and overall health.

## Building Balanced Plates for Pregnancy
To build a balanced plate for pregnancy, expectant mothers can combine these pantry staples in various ways. Here are some suggestions:
- Breakfast: oats with Greek yogurt and fruit.
- Lunch: leafy green salad with lentils, eggs, and low-mercury salmon.
- Dinner: leafy green soup with lentils and chicken.

## Food Safety During Pregnancy
Expectant mothers need to be mindful of food safety during pregnancy. The following foods should be avoided:
- Raw or undercooked foods.
- Foods high in mercury.
- Foods containing listeria.

## Conclusion
Pregnancy nutrition is a critical aspect of the pregnancy process. Expectant mothers need to provide their bodies with the necessary nutrients to ensure the health and well-being of both mother and baby. International pantry staples such as oats, Greek yogurt, lentils, low-mercury salmon, eggs, leafy greens, and citrus are good options for pregnant women. To build a balanced plate for pregnancy, expectant mothers can combine these pantry staples in various ways and be mindful of food safety.
